reasoning_effort_note: docs.x.ai/developers/models does not state whether grok-4.3 accepts reasoning_effort; the broker forces it into the request regardless (existing ENFORCED behavior) and the probe must record whether xAI accepts or rejects the field.
price_source: https://docs.x.ai/developers/models, fetched 2026-09-24: grok-4.3 (prompts <200k tokens) is $1.25 input / $2.50 output per million tokens. This proposal applies the same 10% conservative markup already used for grok-4.7 in this run's broker-config.json (1.25*1.1=1.375, 2.50*1.1=2.75).
